name: Living Together
source:
Oliver fulfilled his dream of living alone... But he realized that it was anything but a dream. Boredom consumed his life... And porn too. He could hardly have imagined that his life would cross paths with the so-called true love... Making him able to achieve happiness... For better, or for worse? I'm sure you can find out.

[From F95Zone]
